Light with a frequency of `5.60xx10^14` `text(Hz)` `(text(Hertz))` is used to test the behavior of light through the different substances. The velocity of light `(v)` is measured as the product of frequency `(f)` and wavelength `(lambda)`:
Figure `1` shows a polymer marble before and after it is dropped into a glass of distilled water. As indicated, the light changes velocity when it passes through each substance.
Table `1` shows light velocity data, in `text(meters per second)` `(text(m)/text(s))`, for various substances.
